name: NetSights ‑ Store Insights
author: netsightsai

sections.description:
NetSights connects your WooCommerce store to Netsights.ai for real-time revenue intelligence and D2C analytics.

Key Features:

🔴 Real-time Webhooks — Every order, customer, and product event is pushed instantly to Netsights.ai:
– Orders created, status changed, updated, refunded, deleted
– Customers created and updated
– Products created, updated, deleted, stock changes
– Checkout completed events with full attribution data

📅 Daily Reconciliation Sync — Runs automatically at 2:00 AM every day:
– Syncs all orders modified in the last 26 hours (2-hour overlap for safety)
– Full product catalog refresh
– Active customer data (ordered in last 30 days)
– Daily summary with AOV, COD/prepaid split, revenue totals

📦 6-Month Historical Import — On first install, imports your last 6 months of data in background batches:
– Products → Orders → Customers (phased, non-blocking)
– 50 orders / 100 products / 100 customers per batch
– Progress tracking with live UI updates
– Can be re-run or cancelled from admin

🇮🇳 D2C India Optimized:
– COD vs Prepaid classification
– Pincode-to-tier mapping (Tier 1/2/3)
– Repeat buyer detection (registered + guest)
– UTM/attribution capture (WooCommerce built-in + Google Analytics)
– Coupon and discount analytics
– Shipping method tracking

External Services

This plugin connects to the Netsights.ai API to sync your WooCommerce store data for revenue intelligence and analytics.

What the service is and what it is used for:
The Netsights.ai API is used to send your store’s orders, customers, products, and checkout events to the Netsights.ai platform. This enables real-time revenue intelligence, D2C analytics, persona insights, and performance tracking.

What data is sent and when:
– Orders: Order details, line items, customer information, payment method, shipping details, and attribution data (UTM parameters) are sent when orders are created, updated, or status changes occur.
– Customers: Customer profiles including email, order history, and billing/shipping information are sent when customers are created or updated.
– Products: Product catalog data including prices, stock levels, categories, and variants are sent during initial import and when products are updated.
– Checkout Events: Checkout completion events with full attribution data are sent in real-time when orders are placed.
– Daily Sync: A daily reconciliation sync runs at 2:00 AM server time to ensure data consistency, sending orders modified in the last 26 hours, full product catalog, and active customer data.

Service Terms and Privacy:
This service is provided by Netsights.ai. Please review their terms of service and privacy policy:
– Terms of Service: https://netsights.ai/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://netsights.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload netsights-store-insights to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin
  3. Go to NetSights settings and enter your API Key from app.netsights.ai
  4. Configure your Store ID
  5. Click “Test Connection” to verify
  6. The 6-month historical import will begin automatically
sections.faq:
How do I get my API Key?

Visit https://api.netsights.ai/settings/api and copy your live API key.

Is there a free trial?

Yes, start your free trial at https://netsights.ai

What data is sent to Netsights?

Orders, customers, products, and checkout/attribution data. No sensitive customer PII is sent.

Can I disable real-time webhooks?

Yes, toggle “Real-time Webhooks” in the plugin settings.

Can I control the daily sync?

Yes, enable/disable it or manually trigger it from the plugin admin page.
